description: This file defines the ConciergeConfig interface, which provides configuration settings for the Concierge service, including enforcement, caches, aggregation, and persistence cleanup configurations. It extends other configuration interfaces related to health checks and MongoDB.

classes.name: ConciergeConfig
classes.description: An interface providing various configuration settings for the Concierge service, including enforcement, caches, aggregation, and persistence cleanup.

methods.name: getEnforcementConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of Concierge's enforcement behavior.

methods.name: getCachesConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration related to Concierge's caches.

methods.name: getThingsAggregatorConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for things aggregation in Concierge.

methods.name: getPersistenceCleanupConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for persistence cleanup actions.
